implementation.scope: Every per-capability payload node prepares fallibly before authority mutation and installs by relinking. Detached payload and shared authority metadata stay paired through post-IPC disposal.
implementation.preparation: PreparingCapability retains shared authority reservation and payload node in one inert owner, including rejection after count admission. Existing parent endpoint/call/connection/receive/reply owners finish unused preparation after IPC unlock, with their existing exact roots last. Factories still execute under IPC.
implementation.publication: No per-capability BTreeMap insertion remains. Shared authority/memory publish jointly, followed by prepared node relinking under the same IPC hold. Direct grants become visible there; queued and unobserved returned connections stay hidden until receive or first result observation. Installation checks live target authority.
implementation.retirement: Connection counts live in node admission, independently of payload. Removing a capability attaches its detached shared RetiredRecord to the payload node before linking into existing temporary cleanup lists. Post-IPC authority disposal precedes payload/node free and original connection refund. Fallback retains both metadata nodes and original accounts.
implementation.receive: One containing owner retains preparation and speculative retirement through guard exit. Result-page rejection removes only speculative reply capability; queue/token/loans/result bytes remain intact. Scalar/vector forms share the path; one-way receive prepares no reply capability.
implementation.reply: Scalar completion keeps unused grant preparation and detached metadata with notifications. Claimed reply disposes these fields post-IPC before existing roots finish. Ordinary failure refunds unused grants; abandonment retains them with reply claim/roots. Existing unstarted returned-memory escrow fallback is unchanged.

controls.existing_reply_abandonment_fixture: Now requires one extra original shared reservation, private capability node and connection count retained with the existing reply claim/roots; destination has no live authority. Existing loan/backing/root and unstarted memory-escrow checks remain enabled.
controls.injection_qualification: Explicit stage rejection around real admitted allocations, not global allocator exhaustion.

remaining: payload and shared-authority factories still execute under outer IPC guard
other waiter/vector/control-block factories, weak retention and payload destructors
linear registry lookup/insertion and repeated reference/close scans; wider IRQ/guard contexts and pressure fairness
historical mapping panic and root-close timeout causes
